author: Steve Wallis
description:
Hey guys! I have @mav with me on this adventure. You can check out his channel here: https://www.youtube.com/@mav

We put a second story on my motorhome so he would have a comfortable place to camp for the night. We made a trip to the Habitat for Humanity Restore and picked up some building materials, and they worked out nicely. It was just a quick bit of construction in the bush and our camping rig was ready to go. It was a fine campground area on crown land so we had much more freedom than a traditional campground. We had a few laughs, and quite a fun adventure in amateur construction and unusual camping.
